The problem names B as the magnetic field magnitude (magnetic flux density). The cited record pq_magnetic_flux_density defines magnetic flux density (tesla) with SI dimension M T^-2 I^-1 (dimension_vector [1,0,-2,-1,0,0,0]). This matches the intended physical quantity and usage of B in the MHD generator problem.
